stories.title: Ukraine and Russia hit by fake emergency alerts
stories.take: Hackers hit both Ukraine's and Russia's emergency alert apps on Sunday night — Kyiv received fake warnings of nuclear radiation, chemical attacks and street fighting for over an hour, and Moscow's app carried jokey fake alerts hours later; who hit whom is unresolved • The humanitarian ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshki, partly brokered by Melania Trump, ended at midnight and explosions followed within seconds • Ohio early voting is running at presidential-election levels on the final day of midterm campaigning • BBC Panorama got rare access inside Iran a year after the crackdown — a medic describes patients shot in the head, neck and genitals 'with the intent to kill'

stories.title: DF Direct Weekly #288: Phantom Blade Zero PC Tested, FSR 4.1 Handheld, Switch 2 Lite?
stories.take: On the 'Switch 2 Lite?' question: there is no Nintendo rumor — only supposition around Samsung's new 8nm node, and DF calls a ~15% power saving a weak basis for a Lite when the Switch 1 shrink halved power; they would rather see a 5nm port and an OLED screen • Phantom Blade Zero's PC port is a good one — an RTX 4060 runs it at 1440p and 60+ fps — but shader compilation takes 20–25 minutes and Reflex only seems to work with frame generation on • FSR 4.1 on ROG Ally handhelds is the real headline: its Performance mode upscales 540p and still looks clearly better than FSR 3 Quality from 720p, while running faster • Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is broken on PS5 Pro, rendering at 1080p where base PS5 and Xbox render a clean 4K

stories.title: Outrage over NoHo ICE encounter, 2nd Palisades Fire trial begins, Rams beat Chargers— Morning Edition
stories.take: UCLA's Voting Rights Project found more than 40% of the names on the feds' list of 20,000 alleged non-citizen California voters are not on the state's voter rolls at all • Outrage over a North Hollywood ICE encounter caught on video — an agent pointed a gun at a bystander's face during an arrest; Mayor Bass is calling for an investigation • Jury selection was expected to start today in the second Palisades Fire arson trial, and DASH bus-lane cameras switch on today — warnings for 60 days, then tickets of nearly $300 • Rams beat the Chargers 49–20 and the Lakers beat Toronto 131–125 behind Luka Dončić's 45 points

stories.title: Michigan Democrats Feud, Midterm Map Shifts, US-Iran Diplomacy Efforts
stories.take: Haley Stevens revoked her endorsement of Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday and backed Republican Mike Rogers instead, citing his comments around Israel — Chuck Schumer called it 'a despicable betrayal' and her longtime chief of staff quit • A federal judge dismissed the DOJ lawsuit that tried to block certification of Alaska's Senate race if incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan loses • The turmoil re-exposes the party's fault lines over identity heading into 2028, with Michigan one of the earliest primary states, and holding the seat is key to Democrats retaking the Senate

stories.title: A Political Rebellion in the Rio Grande Valley
stories.take: Rio Grande Valley construction builders — deeply conservative and many of them Trump voters — are rebelling after ICE raids emptied job sites, with more than 9,000 people deported from the area • One small builder fell from about 25 houses in a normal year to 12, with contracts for only 3 going into 2026, as crews were taken mid-job and framers vanished • The Valley is expected to swing harder away from Trump than almost anywhere in the country on Tuesday

stories.title: Democratic Dust-up Puts Must-Win Seat at Risk
stories.take: Stevens crossed the aisle to endorse Mike Rogers after a breakdown over an outside-group ad she called antisemitic — the move baffled Democrats and put a must-win Senate seat at risk • El-Sayed distanced himself from the ad, accused Stevens of distracting from affordability, and said he does not think about her at all • Trump closed his midterm push with rallies in Iowa and Kansas — where Sen. Roger Marshall's race is now a toss-up — plus a speech tonight at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool

stories.title: Why Peacock is making a huge bet on YouTube
stories.take: The answer: Peacock's shows already live on YouTube as clips, but those viewers mostly don't subscribe — so YouTube is incremental audience, not cannibalization • Next year Peacock's ad tier bundles with a tier of YouTube Premium, and Strauss says the subscribers should be mostly people who don't have Peacock today • The deal also deepens NBCU's YouTube TV distribution and ad-targeting integration, and Strauss predicts Peacock will be one of the top distributed streaming services in the US within a year

stories.title: The Stock Market Is Already Pricing In A Democratic Sweep
stories.take: Bottom line from both hosts: a Democratic sweep is already priced in and is their base case — they predict Democrats take both the House and the Senate on Tuesday, so the sweep itself is not a fresh trade • Evidence: health care is up more than 9% over three months on expectations Medicaid cuts get reversed, and defense stocks already fell over the summer • Kalshi puts a blue wave at 82% and a full sweep at about 65–67%; September PCE inflation hit 3.6%, the highest since May, with real wages down for a sixth straight month

stories.title: The $300 Billion Structured Notes Market Is Booming
stories.take: US SEC-registered structured notes are on track for about $300 billion this year, up from about $200 billion last year • Rising markets keep knocking autocallables out early, so the same money is repeatedly re-issued — the fastest growth is worst-of autocallables on the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Russell • Buyers are high-net-worth clients via private banks chasing higher yield plus a downside buffer they cannot build in listed markets, and AI turbulence fuels both yield-chasing and demand for protection

stories.title: How crypto world made inroads in Pakistan
stories.take: The answer: Pakistan reversed its eight-year crypto ban in 2025 — creating the Pakistan Crypto Council and a regulator to license exchanges, signing deals linked to the Trump family's World Liberty Financial, and giving Binance and HTX initial clearance to apply • Analysts tie the timing to Trump's second-term crypto promotion and read the pivot as Pakistan courting his administration; pardoned Binance founder Changpeng Zhao advises the council • The open risk: a fatwa from Mufti Taqi Usmani and other scholars who say crypto lacks the intrinsic, tangible value Islamic finance requires — even as Pakistan ranks third globally for crypto adoption

stories.title: Trump celebrates shock endorsement ahead of US midterms
stories.take: Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens gave the shock endorsement, backing Republican Mike Rogers over Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed just days before the midterms — Trump welcomed it at a rally • Polls show a surge in support for Democrats even in states reliably Republican for decades, and Democrats will very likely take the House • Cost of living is the key issue: voters across key states blame Trump directly for soaring prices, including his decision to go to war in Iran
